name: Braddell
summary: NSL interchange pocket between Toa Payoh and Bishan — practical mid-town HDB/condo mix with hub-adjacent errands and less tourist gloss.
body: Braddell is the shortlist when North-South Line interchange practicality and mid-town heartland texture matter more than café branding. The station pocket sits between Toa Payoh Hub gravity and Bishan park/interchange pull; housing mixes mature HDB with selective condo edges. Expats land here for manageable CBD hops and walkable errands without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: peak station congestion, older-block ops, and HDB eligibility checks for foreigners. Compare with Toa Payoh Central for hub density, Balestier for food-spine living, and Bishan when park + Circle Line matter more.
bestFor: households comparing Toa Payoh vs Bishan edges
people who want ActiveSG pool programmes without condo coaching premiums
watchOuts: HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval checks
housingMix: Mature HDB dominant with selective condo / executive pockets.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Braddell; Toa Payoh and Bishan adjacency depending on block. Time Tuesday 08:15 door-to-desk before you LOI.
